Method of Attack: Exploiting CVE-2022-22954 remote code execution vulnerability in VMware Workspace ONE Access (Identity Manager) to execute PowerShell commands, fetch a highly obfuscated loader from a command and control (C2) server, and load a Core Impact agent into system memory
Impacted Systems: VMware Workspace ONE Access (formerly VMware Identity Manager)
Attack Vector: Remote code execution vulnerability CVE-2022-22954 without requiring administrative access
Indicators of Compromise: PowerShell command execution on vulnerable Identity Manager service
Fetching PowerTrash loader from C2 server
Use of Core Impact agent loaded into memory
Reverse HTTPS backdoors including Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, or Core Impact beacons
